name: Ramp
text: We should add a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #ffffff offset to interactive elements, as it provides a clear visual indication of focus for keyboard users. This decision prioritizes visual clarity over a minimalistic design, accepting the trade-off of slightly increased visual noise. The extra width and inner offset ensure the focus ring is visible on various backgrounds, making it accessible for users with visual impairments. By making this choice, we're putting quality and usability first, even if it means a slightly more prominent design element.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks colliding with adjacent elements in dense UIs, making it harder to distinguish focus from content. A 2px ring with a 1px inner offset balances clarity and minimalism—test it at 125% zoom on a low-DPI screen to confirm it doesn’t blur.
